Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: rat shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn to take the shape of a rat. Small, agile, and unnoticed.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: wolf shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn to hold the shape of a pack hunter: fast, lean, and built to run prey down over distance.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: cougar shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn the shape of an ambush killer, trading the wolf's endurance for a burst of lethal speed.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: muffalo shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn the shape of a herd beast: heavy, placid, and strong enough to carry a load as easily as it takes a hit.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: bear shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn the shape of a bear, where precision gives way to mass and the simple authority of claws.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: megasloth shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Learn the shape of a megasloth, which asks the druid to hold something far larger than themselves and keep hold of it.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: scurrying speed
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Master the rapid, darting gait of a rodent. Increases wild shape move speed by +0.50 c/s.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: pack pursuit
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Attune to the wolf's tireless loping stride. Increases wild shape move speed by +0.60 c/s.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: ambush lethalness
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Hone the cat's predatory reflexes. Increases wild shape melee hit chance by +2.0.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: thick wool
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Weave thick layers of insulating wool. Grants wild shape +20% blunt armor.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: iron hide
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Harden the bear's dense muscle and fat layers. Grants wild shape +25% sharp armor.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: ancient plating
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Thicken the megasloth's sub-dermal osteoderms. Grants wild shape +30% sharp armor.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: enduring shape
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Anchor your animal forms deeper into your spirit. Multiplies shift duration by x1.5.

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: swift return
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Ease the strain of shedding animal essence. Cuts wild shape cooldown in half (x0.5).

Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.label: mending revert
Druidkin.WildShapeNodeDef.description: Returning to human form knits wounded flesh and seals lacerations. Restores up to 20 health across injuries on revert.
